import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox
import sqlite3

class RoadConditionReporter:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        self.root.title("Road Condition Reporter")
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect("road_conditions.db")
        self.cursor = self.conn.cursor()

        # Create table if it doesn't exist
        self.cursor.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS road_conditions (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                location TEXT NOT NULL,
                condition TEXT NOT NULL,
                reported_by TEXT NOT NULL,
                reported_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            );
        """)
        self.conn.commit()

        # Create GUI components
        self.location_label = tk.Label(root, text="Location:")
        self.location_label.pack()
        self.location_entry = tk.Entry(root)
        self.location_entry.pack()

        self.condition_label = tk.Label(root, text="Condition:")
        self.condition_label.pack()
        self.condition_entry = tk.Entry(root)
        self.condition_entry.pack()

        self.report_button = tk.Button(root, text="Report", command=self.report_condition)
        self.report_button.pack()

        self.view_button = tk.Button(root, text="View Reports", command=self.view_reports)
        self.view_button.pack()

    def report_condition(self):
        location = self.location_entry.get()
        condition = self.condition_entry.get()
        if location and condition:
            self.cursor.execute("INSERT INTO road_conditions (location, condition, reported_by) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (location, condition, "User"))
            self.conn.commit()
            messagebox.showinfo("Success", "Condition reported successfully!")
        else:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", "Please enter both location and condition.")

    def view_reports(self):
        self.cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM road_conditions")
        reports = self.cursor.fetchall()
        report_window = tk.Toplevel(self.root)
        report_window.title("Reports")
        report_text = tk.Text(report_window)
        report_text.pack()
        for report in reports:
            report_text.insert(tk.END, f"Location: {report[1]}\nCondition: {report[2]}\nReported by: {report[3]}\n\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = tk.Tk()
    app = RoadConditionReporter(root)
    root.mainloop()
```
